batting.name: S Dhawan
batting.dismissal: c SK Raina b SB Jakati

batting.name: SR Tendulkar
batting.dismissal: c MS Dhoni b L Balaji

balls.text: again full and straight, just another single to long-on. Fine over this from Malinga .
full delivery, driven to Tiwary at long-off. Just a single.
yorker length well outside off, Raina tries to reach out but doesn't connect
slings across yet another full delivery, mistimes the slog to midwicket
really full delivery, Raina can't do much with it except driving it straight to long-off
stays well back inside the crease and drives the full delivery to cover
low full toss well outside off stump, sliced to third man
yorker ends up as a low dipping full toss, run down to third man
low full toss, swung away to wide midwicket boundary, well clear of Tiwary manning the deep
driven down to long-on for a single
Fifty for Badri as well. He brings it up by smashing the full delivery to the long-on boundary
pretty full in length, Raina can't get under the ball, drives to long-on
yorker length on the off stump line, Badri lifts the front leg in the air and whips it to fine-leg region
driven hard through to deep cover for a single
really full delivery, whipped away to deep midwicket
goes for the yorker, turned to square-leg
whip-flicks the full delivery to right of deep midwicket
Whack! Badrinath clears the front foot and thrashes the length delivery to the straight boundary
really full delivery on middle and leg, turned to fine-leg
the slightly slower bouncer around off, Badri opens-up his stance and pulls it away to wide midwicket boundary
goes for the yorker but slips it down the leg side
Another yorker, again dug out to Pollard who doesn't throw this time
yorker outside off stump, dug out to backward point and Pollard misses the stumps. Overthrows.
The Raina heave over wide midwicket. He clears the front foot and biffs the short-of-length delivery over the boundary. It was the slightly slower one.
slips in a slower one and Raina is way too early with his slog and misses the ball completely
length delivery outside off stump, Badri tries to swing it to the on side but has to be contend just picking up a leg bye
the bouncer arrives, Raina seems to have taken his eyes off the ball but goes through with his swat-pull and connects
goes for the yorker, accurate too, dug out to the on side
fullish on the off stump line, sliced away to deep cover .. Bravo fires the throw to Zaheer Khan ..
full and straight, driven to mid-off
slower one, full, just about lifted over short straight cover
banged in short, pulled away to deep square-leg .. doesn't quite connect well
full delivery, hit down to long-off.
goes down the track and drives to long-on
tries to swing it to the on side but can't beat short midwicket
clears the front foot and tries to heave the full toss over midwicket but makes a mess of it .. the ball rolls through mid-on
moves outside leg and cuts to short third man
leans forward to wrist the off break from outside off past square-leg
moves towards off side and swings the full length delivery to long-leg
full in length on the middle stump line, Badri moves outside leg stump line and edges the intended off drive to the leg side
tries the slower one but loses direction
fullish outside off, steered to backward point
low dipping full toss, pushed to long-off
slower one, on the middle stump line, Badri edges the off drive to the on side
moves forward to crash a low full toss to wide long-on boundary
low full toss outside off, sliced away but Pollard intercepts at backward point

fullish, outside off stump, Raina stays adjacent to the line, crouches and steers it to left of wide third man where Harbhajan Singh makes a mess of it .. he doesn't' get down in time and lets the ball slip through his fingers
fires it in full, almost a yorker , pushed out through mid-on
full and down the leg side .. wide
really full one, Badri edges the drive to his pad
moves outside leg stump, gets ready for the big hit over covers but picks up the slower one late .. he adjusts by taking the bottom-hand off the handle and slices the ball over backward point
fires it in full and straight, raina brings up his fifty with a punch down to long-off . His sixth IPL fifty
he expected the short delivery and moved towards the offside but failed to connect with the pull shot ..
stays back to swat the back-of-length delivery to deep midwicket
a beamer down the leg side ... high full toss moves past Raina
moves outside leg stump and late cuts the length delivery from middle-stump line to third man
forced away wide of Shikhar Dhawn at sweeper cover
short in length, steered to Pollard at backward point
full in length, on the middle, turned to deep midwicket
full delivery just outside leg stump, rolls of the pad
slower one outside off stump, run down to third man
sprays it full and just down the leg side
fires in a bouncer on the leg stump line, Badri is late on the pull and edges it ,  Tare is late on the jump and the ball flies to the boundary
The slowish bouncer .. Badri can't connect with his upper cut and it bounces once before it reaches the keeper
second slower one, this time outside off, run down to third man
Malinga starts off with slower one, on the middle and leg, turned to fine-leg region.
short in length, swatted through midwicket
short in length around off stump, dabbed wide of midwicket for a single that would bring Raina back on strike
leans forward to work the length delivery past square-leg
Low full toss around off stump line, Raina crouches, opens the bat-face and guides it superbly to backward point boundary
The Raina shot. Heave over midwicket. He has done it often enough now. He cleared the front foot and swung the short-of-length delivery over wide midwicket
leans forward and across to push the length delivery to the off side
stays back to clip it away to the on side
moves outside leg stump, and it looked like he was almost beaten by the flight and the turn but adjusted at the last minute to dab it to short third man
goes well back to turn it behind square-leg
pushes it through quicker, edged wide of short third-man
gives width outside leg stump and Raina pulls it away to the long-leg boundary
full in length, punched to long-off region
tip and run .. pushed to the off side and off they go. Pollard has a shy at the non-striker's end, Raina dives back to the crease. Had the throw found its mark, it could have got interesting
from round the stumps, a lifting delivery that seemed to have cramped-up Raina but he wriggles free with a lovely upper cut. He arched back to create room and managed to connect. Neat.
cuts in to the clip the pad and they collect a leg bye
full in length and outside off, steered straight to backward point. Badri can't get a single here
length delivery around off stump, another dot ball.. a defensive push to cover
leans forward to defend the length delivery to the off side
Another dot ball and it's yet another fine tight over from Bhajji.. He has been bowling really well this IPL.
goes for the sweep and edges it to the on side
leans across to push the off break to point for a single
flighted around leg stump, turns in, nudged to square-leg
flighted outside off, eased past Harbhajan who should have stopped it
stretches forward to punch it to long-off
bouncing short of length delivery outside off, dabbed to third man
kicks up from short of length, cut to point
short in legnth on the middle and leg, tucked behind square-leg
There you go! Bravo finally bowls it short at Raina who hops to jab it away to the on side
Gorgeous shot. Full in length outside off stump and Raina plays a peachy punchy extra-cover drive
Swat-flick! It was full in length and around the leg stump line, Raina swat-flicks it, ala Moin Khan used to do in the 90's, for a six over backward square-leg

Ah! what a way to go! It was the attempted yorker that ended up as a low dipping full toss curving away. Patel had moved outside leg stump and tried to adjust to the curving full delivery by flicking it but missed and also lost his balance. The ball hit the pad and fell on the stumps!
moves outsidee leg stumpp, McLaren slips in a slower one, pushed out to left of mid-off
short in length, outside off stump, run down to third man
length delivery around off stump line, jabbed out to the on side
length delivery on the off stump line, pushed out to point
moves outside leg and drives hard to covers where Tiwary makes a diving half-stop
on the pads, turned to square-leg
stretches well forward to defend

It's the skidding slider from round the stumps that has taken out Haydos! Super delivery that. It landed on a length outside off and skidded in, with the angle, and Hayden tried to push it out to the off side but pushed his bat outside the line and was trapped in front.
outside off stump, Hayden fails to connect with his shot and Tare collects
spins down the leg side and Tare does well to gather it
Nicely flicked away or as they say, pick-up shot. It was again on the legs and Patel wrists it up and over square-leg
another yorker attempted, sprays it down the leg-side, though
full toss, perhaps Hayden was surprised as he pats it calmly to mid-off
full in length and cutting away from middle stump line, Hayden gets a leading edge on the attempted on drive and the ball rolls to cover
tries the yorker, ends as a low full toss and Hayden holds his balance to flick it from outside off to deep midwicket
full in length and just outside leg stump, Patel fails to put it away and will collect a leg bye...
full in length around middle and off line, defended on the front foot
Zaheer moves to round the stumps now and fires a high bouncer, left alone
Whaddaplayaaaa! He has almost decapitated Zak. He moved forward to scythe through the line of a back-of-length delivery and smashed it past Zaheer!
It's 2003 World-cup all over again. Hayden taking Zaheer to the cleaners. He took a positive forward stride out and crashed the short-of-length delivery over point.
Bang. Full in length and outside off stump and Hayden plays a crunchy square drive over point.
Edged to third man boundary. Zaheer got it to move away from Hayden who went for the big off drive and ended up slashing it over the slip cordon
takes a forward stride and heaves the length delivery to Malinga at mid-on
swing and a miss.. It was well outside the off stump and Hayden couldn't reach it
back of  length and outside off stump, Patel tries to cut it but doesn't get any wood on leather
on the middle and leg line, Patel presses back to clip it towards deep midwicket
fullish, around the off stump line, driven crsiply square of the wicket where R Sathish, a very good fielder, makes a diving stop to his left
landed just outside leg and hit Parthiv on the pads in front of the stumps ..
length delivery, around 134 kmph, bit of shape in, towards the middle stump, Hayden was getting ready for the big swinging drive and edges it to the on side
It's a lefty on strike and McLaren slips it down the leg side
length delivery came in from outside leg stump line, worked through midwicket
pulls it away to midwicket and that's game set and match Mumbai
Bravo levels the score with yet another flamboyant flick over long-on. Not square-leg mind you but over long-on. Very stylish
slower one, full outside off, drives to cover
squeezes the fuller one for a single

The slow bouncer just outside the off stump line, Tendulkar goes for the pull and top edges it right up in the air and Dhoni moves forward to take it. He has nearly taken his team through but has fallen short just near the line .. Will there be a twist?
How many is too many? Yet another full toss. Tendulkar square-drives it to the point boundary. It's highest Twenty20 score, screams Danny Morrison
full and straight, mistimes the drive to long-on.
slower one well outside off, rolls under the bat and Dhoni collects
The full tosses keep coming. What a night. It was well outside off, Tendulkar opened the bat-face to caress it to the backward point boundary
low dipping full toss, on driven to long-on
that typically flamboyant flick from Bravo .. couple of runs to wide long-on region
really full delivery outside off, squeezed out to backward point
on the middle and leg, tapped to backward square-leg
leans forward to defend to the on side
Moooraaleeee! It was the top spinner this time that moved outside off, Pollard chops the intended cut on to his stumps
Chipped away for a six! Oh what a shot. He leaned forward, suddenly seemed to decide to go for it and scoop-flicked it over long-on
moves down the track to drive to right of long-off
leans forward to play a very compact looking defensive stroke!
Crowd have gone mad. Would you believe it,  it was yet another full toss. Pollard picks the wide long-on boundary this time.
Oh well. Another full toss. Blink. The ball has been picked from midwicket boundary. KP had whipped it away.
clears the front foot and goes for the big swing to the on side but squeezes it to the off side
What is happening out there?! ANother full toss. Tendulkar would have put that in sleep. Flicked away to fine-leg boundary.
another full toss, this time on the off stump line, Tendulkar flicks it to deep backward square-leg region for couple of runs
starts off with a low easy full toss on the leg stump. Thank you, come again says Tendulkar who glances it to fine-leg boundary
nicely flighted delivery drifting towards leg and middle, Pollard tries to whip it over midwicket but is beaten in flight and it runs off his pad, past Dhoni
moves towards off stump and works it wide of short fine-leg fielder.
turns from middle, tries to dab it to the on side and gets a leading edge back down the pitch
on the off and middle, worked right of midwicket
tries to work it to the on side .. the ball rolls towards short midwicket.. the batsmen stop , look at each other but decide to run eventually and TEndulkar gets between the throw and the stumps..
Fab strike. He eased down the track and lifted it carefully over extra cover. Superb inside-out lofted hit.
Wallop! Pollard smashes the slightly short delivery to wide midwicket boundary
slower one outside off, run down to third man
bangs it in short, pulled to deep midwicket
another dot ball. Length delivery has been pushed back to Jogi
Joginder ends Sathish's misery. Not a bad thing to happen for Mumbai. It was a length delivery sliding in towards middle, Sathish tried to swing it to the on side but missed. Timber.
really full delivery, pushed out to the on side for a single
taps it towards deep square-leg for a single
short in length and moving away from the off stump, Tendulkar rocked back to cut it past backward point
quickish slider outside off, Tendulkar pushes inside the line and is beaten
leans forward to wrist the off break from around off past square-leg
Tendulkar's first six in this IPL. He rushed down the track and swung it from outside off over long-on boundary
goes down on his knee to sweep it to deep backward square-leg region
walks down the track and towards off to drive to sweeper cover
low full toss around off stump line, swatted towards deep square-leg
charges down the track and drives hard to left of long-off
length delivery outside off stump, Sathish can't connect with his intended big drive. Tendulkar walks across for a chat
full in length, pushed out to Hayden at short cover
fullish, around off, square driven to deep point
leans forward to jab it away to the off side
gets forward to drive to long-off
flighted around middle and off, pushed out back to the bowler
flighted around off, pushed towards cover
on the leg stump line, nurdled to fine-leg
drops it almost on the blockhole, pushed to the on side
leans forward to wrist the off break past square-leg
leans forward to push to cover
goes back to turn the off break to backward square-leg
The Master strikes from round the stumps. It lands around leg stump line, on a length and turns in to trap Tiwary, who was looking to defend, in front.
lands outside leg, spins in to clip the pad and go through to Dhoni
on the leg stump line, on driven to wide long-on region
pushes this through point and will come back for two runs
Dhawan falls after a flamboyant fifty. He moved down the track, looking for the lofted hit, but miscued it towards midwicket where Raina holds on
dropped by Dhoni just outside off stump, tries the late cut and squeezes it to Dhoni who couldn't hold on
quickish , punched down to long-on
works this one towards deep backward square-leg
Babuuuuuuuuuu! That's Dhawan nick name and he has smashed this one over midwicket boundary. He rushed down the track and heaved it over. 50 up as well. Fifty IPL fifty
turns away from Dhawan who cuts to sweeper cover
flighted off break just outside off, driven to long-on
leans forward to flick the full delivery through midwicket ..
spins down the leg side
skips down the track and drags this down to long-on
works this through point
slip in place and there is a loud shout for lbw .. the ball lands oaround leg stump, turns in to hit the back pad ..
lbw shout as Dhawan misses the sweep but is perhaps hit just outside off
skips down the track and lifts it to long-on
Tendulkar moves down the track and ends up slicing it towards deep cover. Bailey rushes in but it lands on practice pitches and bounces right over a stunned Bailey!
on the middle stump line, dabs it back down the pitch
pushes it to cover point for a single
Slap! reverse swept! Dhawan welcomes Jakati with a fierce reverse sweep
leans forward to drive to the off side
tries a bouncer but not pacy enough i guess .. Dhawan plays a crunchy pull over fine-leg. Up up and over
Whack! It was the full delivery around off stump and Dhawan thrashes it over wide midwicket. Full clean swing of the bat
yorker length outside off, Dhawan tries to dig it out and the ball goes under the ball and bounces sharply to right of Dhoni who leaps to stop it
short in length and outside off, Dhawan goes for the cut but doesn't connect
What a lovely leg cutter! Is it Joginder's best delivery ever? It cut away from a length around off and middle and Tendulkar is comprehensively beaten.
cut away to left of backward point where Badri makes a fine a diving stop
short in length and well down the side
Whiplashed! Full delivery, Dhawan clearsn the front foot and whips it to midwicket boundary
Crash! Slightly short in length, pulled away brutally
goes for the big slog across the line, misses, and is hit on the pad
swings the short of length delivery to square-leg boundary
length delivery, clipped past square-leg
short in length around off stump line, punched to left of mid-off
Tendulkar charges down the track, Bala bangs it in short and Tendulkar goes for the pull but gets a lucky fat edge over the keeper
turned to square-leg for a single
length delivery that straightens on the middle stump, Tendulkar tries to heave it over mid-on but misses and is hit on thigh pad.. edged away
back of length, around off stump, mistimes the pull wide of mid-on
slower one outside off stump, Dhawan goes for the big drive and misses it
full length delivery, mistimes the drive to mid-on
reaches forward to punch to mid-off
a full delivery, swings away towards the wide line, Tendulkar tries to reach out before letting it go
backs away a touch and tries to force it away but doesn't connect. Dhoni collects
full delivery just outside off, dragged through midwicket
around the off stump line, pushed out to point
just down the leg side and Bowden extends his arms
short in length, pushed to the off side for a single .. throw from cover goes wide of the stumps .. and they pick up an extra run.
works this wide of mid-on and they come back for the second run
takes a couple of steps down the track, moves towards leg slightly but Balaji cramps with an off cutter and it goes off the back thigh to Dhoni
gos for the slower bouncer, tucked behind square-leg
walks down the track and Bala sprays it really wide outside off ... Poor over so far from Balaji
Not this time, though. Another overpitched delivery well outside off and Dhwan crashes it through extra cover
full delivery well outside off, Dhawan misses out as he edges the intended off drive to the on side
fullish, on the middle, whipped to deep square-leg
walks across, tries to flick but misses and the ball rolls of the pad .. shout for lbw, was it missing leg?
Much fun. It was a length delivery curving away outside off stump, Tendulkar plays a neat punchy drive but the point fielder is slightly late in moving to his right ..
hint of away swing, full and outside off, Tendulkar drives crisply but can't beat cover
fullish, around the off stump line, squeezed out to point
curves in on the middle and leg line, clipped away
kicks up from short of length around off stump line, chopped to backward point
